title: Raw-markup binding (ruby: <%= q.html_safe %>) — review required
description: A ruby template or component binds a value as raw markup: <%= q.html_safe %>. Untrusted input in the value runs as script in victims' browsers. This lexical rule flags the binding; the reviewer confirms the value is trusted or switches to text binding.
remediation: Bind the value as text (default escaped output) or sanitize it against a tag allowlist before raw binding.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the binding regardless of value trust. Call-shaped sinks are separate rules.
